subject: FAN COIL UNIT
source_master: DRAFTED — no master. Phase 1 carried no safety-device tests and no readings for this type.
_sparse_note: FOUR AND THREE, AND THAT IS THE NUMBER. A fan coil has almost no protective devices of its own — its safeties live in the plant that feeds it. Padding this to look like the boiler table would be inventing checks a technician would rightly ignore.

items.label: Motor thermal protection proven where fitted
Condensate overflow switch proven — unit shuts down on high level
items.note: The one protective device a fan coil reliably has, and the one whose failure floods a ceiling.

items.label: Freeze protection proven where the coil sees outdoor air
Access panel / fan guard secure with the unit energized
items.convergence_reason: FIRM PRACTICE — fifty years of Isotherm field practice, cited as the anchor because the code set is silent here. Not dressed as a standard.

_ratification_note: Batch 2 ratified as drafted, no amendments. Firm-practice items approved with their honest hints; stated brevity, the 7b deferral and the conditional section all endorsed.
